_doc: Frozen source config for the HSCPapers desktop app (Phase 1). See desktop/README.md for the full picture.

attribution.catalogue: THSCOnline (https://thsconline.github.io/s/) — papers belong to their schools/authors and NESA.
attribution.siteCodeLicense: MIT (c) 2014 thsconline — covers site code; paper PDFs remain third-party content for bona-fide study use.
attribution.appPolicy: Metadata is cached and refreshed politely. PDFs download ONLY when the user picks them, max 3 at a time, via THSC's official download endpoints (same URLs their own download button uses). No rehosting, no bulk mirroring.

hscIndex.note: Direct NESA doc links. Preferred source for HSC exam papers + marking guidelines.

trialPipeline.how: Listing HTML (yr*/**/trialpapers_*.html, hscpapers_*.html) holds school sections + links of form pdf(this, <viewno>). Bytes live on the maintainer's Google Drive and resolve at download time via the official endpoint below.
trialPipeline.note: Appended per-entry as absolute `url` (our fileUrl() already passes absolute URLs through). No Apps Script internals are scraped.
trialPipeline.workerEndpoints: THSC's official v2 site (thsconline.pages.dev, viewer.js rewritten 2026-05-24) rotates 15 extra Apps Script deployments + the original to spread load. Same data API; the app mirrors that behaviour in Rust (desktop/src-tauri/src/main.rs WORKERS).

mirrors._doc: Public mirrors acknowledged on THSC's own homepage. Download priority: NESA direct > mirror files > THSC script resolver (16-way worker pool). Each catalogue entry keeps its THSC router URL as `fallbackUrl`.

hscportal.match: entry.v (THSC viewno) + entry.n (THSC link text) match our listing entries 1:1; pdfUrl/cf serve direct PDFs (verified anonymously). Coverage: 6,449 trials/assessments/other, all subjects, 1978-2025.
hscportal.credit: HSC Portal (hscportal.app) — community mirror of THSC papers, self-hosted on Cloudflare Pages.

papersdb.match: Server-rendered /browse/<Subject>/<Trials|HSC>[/<School>] pages -> cdn.papersdb.org PDFs named '<School> <Year> <Subject> Trials[ & Solutions].pdf' (THSC's exact naming).
papersdb.credit: PapersDB (papersdb.org) — community fast mirror (Maths & Science), listed on THSC's homepage.

zaxu.note: h5ai file mirror, pre-2020 coverage, all subjects. NOT crawled (JS-rendered listings); reserved as manual fallback.
zaxu.credit: Zaxu mirror (thsc.zaxu.xyz) — community file mirror, listed on THSC's homepage.

policy.userAgent: HSCPapers/1.0 (study use; cached index, on-demand downloads)
